DirEntryExt.meaning: NUL-terminated name (see READ_DIR_ENTRY), then zero padding to maxlen

structs.DirEntryExt_notes: 12-byte packed header (fn-h89/lib/device/rs232/rs232Fuji.cpp:184-189: dirEntryTimestamp 6 + u32 size + flags + mediatype), NOT 13 (13 is the Atari/Apple/ADAM layout with separate is_dir/is_trunc bytes, fujinet-lib/include/fujinet-fuji.h:157-168). fujinet-lib's H89 FujiDirEntry is 12 + filename (fujinet-lib/include/fujinet-fuji.h:170-181).

DirBlock.name: group_count
DirBlock.meaning: number of page groups that follow

DirBlock.name: groups
DirBlock.meaning: each group: flags u8 (bit7 = last group), entry_count u8, data_size u16 LE (excl. 5-byte group header), index u8 (dir_pos/group_size); then entries: [0] year-1970, [1] bit7 dir | month(4 bits), [2] day<<3 | hour>>2, [3] (hour&3)<<6 | minute, [4..6] size u24 LE (0 for dirs), [7] mediatype, [8..] NUL-terminated name (no trailing '/') (fn-h89/lib/FileSystem/directoryPageGroup.h:31-125); whole reply zero-padded to num_pages*256

structs.HostSlot: 32 bytes: NUL-padded host name; 8 slots -> READ/WRITE_HOST_SLOTS = 256 bytes (MAX_HOSTNAME_LEN 32, fn-h89/lib/fuji/fujiHost.h:6; MAX_HOST_SLOTS 8, fn-h89/lib/config/fnConfig.h:10).
structs.DeviceSlot: 38 bytes: hostSlot u8 @0 (0xFF empty), mode u8 @1 (0x01 read, 0x02 write, 0x40 mounted - read only), filename[36] @2 (basename on read, ignored on write); 8 slots -> 304 bytes (fn-h89/lib/device/fujiDevice/fujiDevice.h:72-77; MAX_DISPLAY_FILENAME_LEN 36, fn-h89/lib/fuji/fujiDisk.h:7; MAX_MOUNT_SLOTS 8, fn-h89/lib/config/fnConfig.h:11-15).
structs.AppKeyOpen: 6 bytes: creator u16 LE @0, app u8 @2, key u8 @3, mode i8 @4 (0 read, 1 write, 2 read-256, -1 invalid), reserved u8 @5 (fn-h89/lib/device/fujiDevice/AppKeyMixin.h:8-23).
structs.AppKeyReadReply: u16 LE length n @0, n bytes @2, n <= 64 (fn-h89/lib/device/rs232/rs232Fuji.cpp:407-415).
structs.NewDisk: 262 bytes: numSectors u16 @0, sectorSize u16 @2, hostSlot u8 @4, deviceSlot u8 @5, filename[256] @6 (fn-h89/lib/device/rs232/rs232Fuji.cpp:113-120).
structs.ReplySizes: SCAN_NETWORKS 1, GET_SCAN_RESULT 34, GET_SSID 97, GET_WIFISTATUS 1, GET_WIFI_ENABLED 1, ADAPTERCONFIG 140, ADAPTERCONFIG_EXTENDED 240, READ_HOST_SLOTS 256, READ_DEVICE_SLOTS 304, GET_DEVICE_FULLPATH 256, GET_HOST_PREFIX 256, READ_DIR_ENTRY maxlen (block maxlen*256), GET_DIRECTORY_POSITION 2, STATUS 4, GENERATE_GUID 37, RANDOM_NUMBER 4 (u32), BASE64_*_LENGTH 4 (u32), QRCODE_LENGTH 4 (u32), HASH_LENGTH 1 (u8), HASH_OUTPUT digest length, READ_APPKEY 2+n, DEVICE_READY 512.
